svg.title: Labyrinth from above: Woven tapestry
svg.desc: Labyrinth from above (2D): the maze seen from directly overhead and woven like a tapestry, every corridor and wall a run of warp and weft. The pack of stuffed toys, small amber cats with button eyes, herds two blue-clad guests inward; the guests flee from any toy they see moving, toward the open corridor. The floor reddens thread by thread toward the centre, where the warmth is.
